test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 26 Oct, 2023)
subject: general
question:
A statement is followed by four conclusions. Which of the conclusions is/are true based on the given statement?

**Statement:**

I J

IV) M < D

options.text: Conclusions I and III are true.
Conclusions IV and II are true.

solution:
Given Statement: I Conclusions:

Conclusion I: S → False (S = J ≥ D ≥ F > M > I It gives S > M)

Conclusion II: F = S → False (F ≤ D ≤ S = J It gives F ≤ S)

Conclusion III: I > J → False (I It gives I M → True (M It gives M "Option 1: **Only conclusion IV is true.**".
